q: What goes into the CBAM figure for urea and ammonium sulphate from a Gresik fertiliser complex?
title: Gresik fertiliser CBAM figure
short: Urea, ammonium sulphate and NPK are CBAM goods, and for fertilisers both direct and indirect emissions count. Include natural gas used as fuel and feedstock, process emissions, any nitric acid N2O, embedded emissions of ammonia precursors, and electricity used.
audience: Integrated fertiliser producers in Gresik and East Java and their EU importers

ul: Gas for reforming and steam, as fuel and feedstock.
N2O from any nitric acid unit, as CO2e.
CO2 from sulphuric acid or other units if it arises.

p: Ammonia, nitric acid and urea made on site are precursors of the final fertiliser. Their emissions are attributed to the product they go into, with any bought in from outside added at their supplier's figure.
Electricity consumed counts for fertilisers, using the grid factor or the power plant's figure where the rules allow.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM legislation and guidance
